$doc: Tier manifest for scripts/run-verifies.mjs. Tiers: pure = hermetic Node/tsx (no external network, no dev server, no real ~/FluxLib mutation — a script that writes to FluxLib redirects HOME/XDG_CONFIG_HOME into a scratch dir before flux-core loads AND passes an explicit libPath; verify-hermetic-fluxlib.ts enforces the libPath half) — this is the `npm test` gate; net = hits external APIs (opt-in); ui = curated stable browser suite against the dev server on :1420 (runner spawns one if absent); ui-extra = the full browser sweep (slow; pre-release / polish audits); bundle+startup = need `npm run build` first; electron = need a real Electron run (manual). Groups name cross-tier sets (paper-gate = the paper editor regression suite). New verify scripts MUST be added here to join the gate. presence = the source-shape/regex subset (main-process + build config that headless drivers cannot exercise); these scripts ALSO live in pure (their gate home) — the tier exists for pathMap's electron/** mapping. Execution metadata is authoritative and independent of selectors. Every attempt receives scratch HOME/config/cache/library; blocked and flaky are not passes. Native no-sandbox is explicit test-only FLUX_ELECTRON_NO_SANDBOX=1. Network tests require FLUX_ALLOW_TEST_NETWORK=1.
$pathMap-doc: WS-7.6b: `run-verifies.mjs --changed` maps `git diff` files through these ORDERED entries (first glob match wins per file; matched `run` sets union; any unmatched file falls back to tier:pure). `self` = a changed verify script runs itself. tier:presence and tier:scale entries activate as those tiers land (unknown names warn + skip).

pathMap.$why: A dependency the start-up crawl misses is optimized on first use and every open page is reloaded — under the ui tier that reload lands on whatever gate is running (the 2026-09-26 plot-gallery popup close). The gate runs the real cold crawl and pins every worker-only import into optimizeDeps.include.

2026-09-18 text arrangement — text.ts blockLayout is the ONE source for how a text element's lines sit in their box (align incl. justify, valign, line height, paragraph spacing, tracking); export.ts serializes it for BOTH engines and the slide player binds the same spans, so a change here must clear the pure contract, the live surfaces and the slide/export parity gates.

2026-09-25 the pure mutation core is proved headless by verify-ops (incl. moveElementsToFigure) and through the real drag by the cross-figure gate; the shared store/ops/Xray rule below keeps its slide-stash routing.
2026-09-16 colour collections — fluxplot's colormap + palette definitions bundled by gen-color-collections.mjs; the pickers (palette tabs, the colormap picker, the X-ray colour scales) read them.
Element is the shared Figure/Slide painter; reactive changes require both rendering behavior and dense-scene input checks.
2026-09-25 the editor zoom range lives in ONE module — the wheel (Canvas.svelte) and the toolbar buttons clamp through it; the raster gate proves the deep-zoom path.
2026-09-15 the crosshair cursor family — Canvas.svelte switches the hardware cursors by state, styles/cursors.css holds them, app.css declares the app-wide policy (no pointer hand anywhere).

pathMap.$comment: verify-extension-build.ts covers the same sources but reads extension/dist, so it needs `npm run build` first and is deliberately NOT listed here — a --changed sweep must not demand a build the caller never asked for. CI runs it in the bundle tier, after the build.

pathMap.$why: historyKeys.ts binds Paper's redo chord on Windows, where CodeMirror's stock keymap leaves Ctrl+Shift+Z dead; the gate resolves the chord through CodeMirror's own builder with only the Windows-visible entries.

tokens.css owns the `:root, .ts-scaled` type scale — Paper's per-panel text size is a no-op if that selector list or the calc(px * var(--ts-scale)) shape is edited away, and nothing else would notice.

2026-09-15 Snapshot & annotate — the freeze-and-draw overlay, the pending-snapshot store and the stamp's snapshot field have a pure gate (crop law, anchors, description, ledger roundtrip) and a browser gate (overlay → popover → ledger); the IPC contract pins the win:capture channel.

2026-09-15 surface redesign — the property menu, the X-ray (multi-select, multi-plot roots, Animate selected), the shared anchoring law and the shared animate core have their own gates; the old pathMap had no entry for FluxFigMenu at all.
2026-09-24 Ctrl+S routes by store tenant: Slide mode saves the deck, Figure mode fig/.
2026-09-24 slide PDF export (one page per slide / per build step) and the content-scale applicability note. PowerPoint export (native shapes, SVG plots).
